fileStat:
p='/etc/hostname'
if [ ! -e "$p" ]; then echo 'No such file or directory' >&2; exit 44; fi
if [ ! -f "$p" ]; then echo 'Not a regular file' >&2; exit 45; fi
if [ ! -r "$p" ]; then echo 'Permission denied' >&2; exit 46; fi
wc -c < "$p" | tr -d ' '
readlink -f "$p" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' "$p"
writeFile:
umask 077
p='/tmp/x'
if [ -L "$p" ]; then p=$(readlink -f "$p") || exit 1; fi
if [ -d "$p" ]; then echo 'Is a directory' >&2; exit 45; fi
d=${p%/*}
if [ -z "$d" ]; then d=/; fi
mkdir -p "$d" || exit 1
b=
if [ -e "$p" ]; then b="$p.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"; cp -p "$p" "$b" || exit 1; fi
t=$(mktemp "$d/.pvemcp.XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$t"' EXIT
cat > "$t" || exit 1
if [ -e "$p" ]; then
  m=$(stat -c %a "$p" 2>/dev/null) && chmod "$m" "$t" 2>/dev/null
  o=$(stat -c %u:%g "$p" 2>/dev/null) && chown "$o" "$t" 2>/dev/null
else
  chmod 644 "$t" 2>/dev/null
fi
chmod '0640' "$t" || exit 1
chown 'root:root' "$t" || exit 1
mv -f "$t" "$p" || exit 1
wc -c < "$p" | tr -d ' '
printf '%s\n' "$b"
writeFilePlain:
umask 077
p='/tmp/x'
if [ -L "$p" ]; then p=$(readlink -f "$p") || exit 1; fi
if [ -d "$p" ]; then echo 'Is a directory' >&2; exit 45; fi
d=${p%/*}
if [ -z "$d" ]; then d=/; fi
if [ ! -d "$d" ]; then printf 'No such directory: %s\n' "$d" >&2; exit 44; fi
b=
t=$(mktemp "$d/.pvemcp.XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$t"' EXIT
cat > "$t" || exit 1
if [ -e "$p" ]; then
  m=$(stat -c %a "$p" 2>/dev/null) && chmod "$m" "$t" 2>/dev/null
  o=$(stat -c %u:%g "$p" 2>/dev/null) && chown "$o" "$t" 2>/dev/null
else
  chmod 644 "$t" 2>/dev/null
fi
mv -f "$t" "$p" || exit 1
wc -c < "$p" | tr -d ' '
printf '%s\n' "$b"
lxcInfo:
echo '@@os'; cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null
echo '@@kernel'; uname -srm 2>/dev/null
echo '@@hostname'; hostname 2>/dev/null
echo '@@uptime'; cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null
echo '@@ips'; ip -o addr show 2>/dev/null || ifconfig 2>/dev/null
echo '@@mounts'; cat /proc/mounts 2>/dev/null
exit 0
ports:
if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then ss -tulnp
elif command -v netstat >/dev/null 2>&1; then netstat -tuln
else echo 'Neither ss nor netstat here: raw kernel tables.'; cat /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 /proc/net/udp /proc/net/udp6 2>/dev/null; exit 0
fi
logs:
n='50'
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && { [ -d /run/systemd/system ] || [ -d /var/log/journal ]; }; then
  echo 'source=journal'
  journalctl --no-pager -o short-iso -n '50' && exit 0
fi
for f in /var/log/syslog /var/log/messages; do
  if [ -r "$f" ]; then
    printf 'source=%s\n' "$f"
    tail -n "$n" "$f"
    exit $?
  fi
done
echo 'No journal, and no readable log file in /var/log.' >&2
exit 44
logsUnit:
n='50'
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && { [ -d /run/systemd/system ] || [ -d /var/log/journal ]; }; then
  echo 'source=journal'
  journalctl --no-pager -o short-iso -n '50' -u 'nginx' '--since=-1h' && exit 0
fi
for f in /var/log/'nginx'.log /var/log/'nginx'/current /var/log/'nginx'/'nginx'.log /var/log/syslog /var/log/messages; do
  if [ -r "$f" ]; then
    printf 'source=%s\n' "$f"
    case "$f" in /var/log/syslog|/var/log/messages) grep -F -- 'nginx' "$f" | tail -n "$n"; exit 0;; esac
    tail -n "$n" "$f"
    exit $?
  fi
done
echo 'No journal, and no readable log file in /var/log.' >&2
exit 44
serviceStatus:
if [ -d /run/systemd/system ] && command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=systemd
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=openrc
elif command -v service >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=sysv
else init=none
fi
echo "init=$init"
case "$init" in
  systemd)
echo "active=$(systemctl is-active -- 'nginx' 2>/dev/null)"
echo "enabled=$(systemctl is-enabled -- 'nginx' 2>/dev/null)"
systemctl status --no-pager --lines=20 -- 'nginx' 2>&1
  ;;
  openrc)
if rc-service 'nginx' status >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo active=active; else echo active=inactive; fi
if rc-update show default 2>/dev/null | grep -qw -- 'nginx'; then echo enabled=enabled; else echo enabled=disabled; fi
rc-service 'nginx' status 2>&1
  ;;
  sysv)
if service 'nginx' status >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo active=active; else echo active=inactive; fi
service 'nginx' status 2>&1
  ;;
esac
exit 0
serviceStatusAll:
if [ -d /run/systemd/system ] && command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=systemd
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=openrc
elif command -v service >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=sysv

fi

systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-pager --no-legend 2>&1

rc-status --all 2>&1

service --status-all 2>&1

serviceEnable:
if [ -d /run/systemd/system ] && command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=systemd
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=openrc
elif command -v service >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=sysv
else init=none
fi
echo "init=$init"
case "$init" in
  systemd) systemctl 'enable' -- 'nginx' ;;
  openrc) rc-update add 'nginx' default ;;

esac

  echo manager=apk
  apk update -q && apk add --no-progress 'curl' 'g++'

  if pgrep -x sshd >/dev/null 2>&1; then running=yes; fi

  if pidof sshd >/dev/null 2>&1; then running=yes; fi

if [ -d /run/systemd/system ] && command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=systemd
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=openrc
elif command -v service >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=sysv
else init=none
fi
echo "init=$init"
if [ "$init" = systemd ] && systemctl is-active ssh.socket >/dev/null 2>&1; then running=socket; fi

sshEnable:
sshd=$(command -v sshd 2>/dev/null) || sshd=
if [ -z "$sshd" ] && [ -x /usr/sbin/sshd ]; then sshd=/usr/sbin/sshd; fi
installed=no
if [ -z "$sshd" ]; then
  installed=yes
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then

  echo manager=apt
  apt-get update -q && apt-get install -y -q -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=120 -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold -- openssh-server || exit $?
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo manager=apk
  apk update -q && apk add --no-progress openssh || exit $?
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo manager=dnf
  dnf install -y openssh-server || exit $?
elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo manager=yum
  yum install -y openssh-server || exit $?
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo manager=pacman
  pacman -Syu --noconfirm --needed openssh || exit $?
else
  echo 'No supported package manager found: apt-get, apk, dnf, yum or pacman.' >&2
  exit 47
fi
sshd=$(command -v sshd 2>/dev/null) || sshd=
if [ -z "$sshd" ] && [ -x /usr/sbin/sshd ]; then sshd=/usr/sbin/sshd; fi
fi
if [ -z "$sshd" ]; then echo 'sshd is still missing after the installation.' >&2; exit 1; fi
echo "installed=$installed"
if command -v ssh-keygen >/dev/null 2>&1; then ssh-keygen -A >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
mkdir -p /run/sshd 2>/dev/null
if [ -d /run/systemd/system ] && command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=systemd
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=openrc
elif command -v service >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=sysv
else init=none
fi
echo "init=$init"
case "$init" in
  systemd)
u=sshd
if systemctl cat ssh.service >/dev/null 2>&1; then u=ssh; fi
    if systemctl is-enabled ssh.socket >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl start ssh.socket || exit $?
    else systemctl enable --now "$u" || exit $?
    fi
  ;;
  openrc)
    rc-update add sshd default || exit $?
    rc-service sshd start || exit $?
  ;;
  sysv)
    service ssh start 2>/dev/null || service sshd start || exit $?
  ;;
  *)
    "$sshd" || exit $?
  ;;

sshDisable:
if [ -d /run/systemd/system ] && command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=systemd
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=openrc
elif command -v service >/dev/null 2>&1; then init=sysv
else init=none
fi
echo "init=$init"
case "$init" in
  systemd)
u=sshd
if systemctl cat ssh.service >/dev/null 2>&1; then u=ssh; fi
    if systemctl is-enabled ssh.socket >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl disable --now ssh.socket; fi
    systemctl disable --now "$u" || exit $?
  ;;
  openrc)
    rc-service sshd stop
    rc-update del sshd default
    exit 0
  ;;
  sysv)
    service ssh stop 2>/dev/null || service sshd stop || exit $?
    if command -v update-rc.d >/dev/null 2>&1; then update-rc.d ssh disable; elif command -v chkconfig >/dev/null 2>&1; then chkconfig sshd off; fi
    exit 0
  ;;
  *)
    echo 'No service manager found: cannot disable sshd for good.' >&2; exit 47
  ;;
esac
listKeys:
want='root'
found=
while IFS=: read -r n _p ui gi _g hd _s; do
  if [ "$n" = "$want" ]; then found=1; home=$hd; uid=$ui; gid=$gi; break; fi
done < /etc/passwd
if [ -z "$found" ] || [ -z "$home" ]; then printf 'No such user: %s\n' "$want" >&2; exit 44; fi
dir="$home/.ssh"
file="$dir/authorized_keys"
if [ -f "$file" ]; then cat "$file"; fi
exit 0
addKey:
want='root'
found=
while IFS=: read -r n _p ui gi _g hd _s; do
  if [ "$n" = "$want" ]; then found=1; home=$hd; uid=$ui; gid=$gi; break; fi
done < /etc/passwd
if [ -z "$found" ] || [ -z "$home" ]; then printf 'No such user: %s\n' "$want" >&2; exit 44; fi
dir="$home/.ssh"
file="$dir/authorized_keys"
key='ssh-ed25519 AAAA comment'
blob='AAAA'
if [ -L "$dir" ] || [ -L "$file" ]; then echo 'Refusing to follow a link at ~/.ssh or authorized_keys.' >&2; exit 48; fi
mkdir -p "$dir" || exit 1
if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then : > "$file" || exit 1; fi
chmod 700 "$dir" || exit 1
chmod 600 "$file" || exit 1
chown -h "$uid:$gid" "$dir" "$file" || exit 1
if grep -qF -- "$blob" "$file"; then echo present; exit 0; fi
if [ -s "$file" ] && [ -n "$(tail -c 1 "$file")" ]; then echo >> "$file"; fi
printf '%s\n' "$key" >> "$file" || exit 1
echo added
removeKey:
want='root'
found=
while IFS=: read -r n _p ui gi _g hd _s; do
  if [ "$n" = "$want" ]; then found=1; home=$hd; uid=$ui; gid=$gi; break; fi
done < /etc/passwd
if [ -z "$found" ] || [ -z "$home" ]; then printf 'No such user: %s\n' "$want" >&2; exit 44; fi
dir="$home/.ssh"
file="$dir/authorized_keys"
blob='AAAA'
if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then echo removed=0; exit 0; fi
if [ -L "$dir" ] || [ -L "$file" ]; then echo 'Refusing to follow a link at ~/.ssh or authorized_keys.' >&2; exit 48; fi
count=$(grep -cF -- "$blob" "$file")
if [ "${count:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
  t=$(mktemp "$dir/.pvemcp.XXXXXX") || exit 1
  trap 'rm -f "$t"' EXIT
  grep -vF -- "$blob" "$file" > "$t"
  cat "$t" > "$file" || exit 1
fi
echo "removed=${count:-0}"
sshConfigure:
umask 022
c=/etc/ssh/sshd_config
d=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
sshd=$(command -v sshd 2>/dev/null) || sshd=
if [ -z "$sshd" ] && [ -x /usr/sbin/sshd ]; then sshd=/usr/sbin/sshd; fi
if [ -z "$sshd" ] || [ ! -f "$c" ]; then echo 'sshd is not installed here: pve_lxc_ssh_enable installs it.' >&2; exit 44; fi
n=$(mktemp /tmp/.pvemcp-sshd.XXXXXX) || exit 1
b=$(mktemp /tmp/.pvemcp-sshd.XXXXXX) || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$n" "$b"' EXIT
if [ -d "$d" ] && grep -qiE '^[[:space:]]*Include[[:space:]].*sshd_config\.d' "$c"; then
  t="$d/00-pvemcp.conf"
  layout=dropin
  had=no
  if [ -f "$t" ]; then had=yes; cp -p "$t" "$b" || exit 1; grep -viE '^[[:space:]]*(PermitRootLogin|PasswordAuthentication|PubkeyAuthentication|Port)[[:space:]]' "$t" > "$n"; fi
  printf '%s\n' 'PermitRootLogin no' 'PasswordAuthentication no' 'PubkeyAuthentication yes' 'Port 2222' >> "$n"
else
  t="$c"
  layout=main
  had=yes
  cp -p "$c" "$b" || exit 1
  {
    echo '# BEGIN pvemcp'
    sed -n '/^# BEGIN pvemcp$/,/^# END pvemcp$/p' "$c" | grep -v -e '^# BEGIN pvemcp$' -e '^# END pvemcp$' | grep -viE '^[[:space:]]*(PermitRootLogin|PasswordAuthentication|PubkeyAuthentication|Port)[[:space:]]'
    printf '%s\n' 'PermitRootLogin no' 'PasswordAuthentication no' 'PubkeyAuthentication yes' 'Port 2222'
    echo '# END pvemcp'
    sed '/^# BEGIN pvemcp$/,/^# END pvemcp$/d' "$c" | grep -viE '^[[:space:]]*Port[[:space:]]'
  } > "$n"
fi
echo "layout=$layout"
restore() {
  if [ "$had" = yes ]; then cat "$b" > "$t"; else rm -f "$t"; fi
}
cat "$n" > "$t" || { restore; exit 1; }
chmod 644 "$t" 2>/dev/null
mkdir -p /run/sshd 2>/dev/null
if ! out=$("$sshd" -t 2>&1); then
  restore
  printf 'sshd -t refused this configuration, so the old one was put back: %s\n' "$out" >&2
  exit 65
fi
effective=$("$sshd" -T 2>/dev/null)
bad=
